correctness.rationale: With two explicit unit-valued perfect-matching pair-complement valuations on 2K goods, an allocation counts at most K disjoint completed pairs. Equality forces per alternating even cycle (including double edge) a monochromatic whole-component allocation. The exact EF1 constraints at equality reduce to |2s-K|<=1 for subset sum of component half-sizes. If no such subset exists, choose the first crossing component over floor(K/2), assign 2a+1 consecutive vertices to A and the rest to B; the within- and cross-valuations are exactly floor(K/2) and K-1-floor(K/2), so EF1 holds and U=K-1. This proves the complete alternative and O(K^2) dynamic-programming construction. Independent exhaustive matching/allocation evaluation for sizes 2,4,6,8 goods found the exact predicted optima. The finite cases corroborate but do not prove all K.
